items.title: Spain gives anti-laundering unit power to freeze crypto accounts without a judge
items.summary: Under existing rules, Sepblac could only suspend accounts when requested by a foreign financial intelligence unit.

items.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
items.summary: The breach exposed client and employee contact information at Standard Chartered's crypto custodian, which said no unauthorized transactions took place.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs are bleeding cash and the Fed is unlikely to help
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 26, 2026

items.title: Hong Kong-based crypto trading firm Auros is winding down operations
items.summary: The firm previously estimated it handled 4% of global crypto exchange trading volume and raised $17 million after the FTX collapse.

items.title: Bitcoin little changed, DeFi tokens lead the bounce as U.S. marks Thanksgiving
items.summary: Bitcoin is holding near $60,800 after rebounding from Wednesday's $57,500 low, while DeFi and infrastructure tokens are gaining nearly twice as much.

items.title: Nvidia shipment freeze and U.S. chip curbs put AI stocks under pressure
items.summary: U.S. export controls have halted Nvidia server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries and put billions in data centre financing under review.

items.title: New York Attorney General wins $1.4 billion ruling against founders of crypto trading firm NovaTech
items.summary: AWS Mining and NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddie Petion were ordered to pay $1.37 billion after defrauding hundreds of thousands of people, including 11,000 New Yorkers.

items.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
items.summary: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

items.title: Zcash developers want to phase out older privacy system as a precaution against future attacks
items.summary: Zakura is pushing to stop new payments into Sapling sooner, citing the possibility that AI-assisted discoveries could weaken the math protecting it.

items.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
items.summary: An attacker steered up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power to an impostor pool earlier in November using a weakness most of the industry's largest pools still carry.

items.title: How EU brokers could lose access to Kyrgyz crypto exchanges
items.summary: A vote on Kyrgyzstan could make an exchange’s home country the deciding factor in whether a European broker can use it to settle a trade.

items.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
items.summary: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: 7 bizarre things crypto whales spent a fortune on
items.summary: The crypto rich have spent their fortunes on everything from dinosaur skeletons to rotting fruit, with some purchases defying belief.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin calls for verifiable chips as hardware wallet threats evolve
items.summary: Buterin warned that future attacks could use lookalike chips with hidden malicious functions, making hardware tampering harder to detect.

items.title: Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody suffers data breach
items.summary: Zodia Custody’s CEO said the breach exposed names and email addresses of some clients and employees and was detected by the company Monday.

items.title: Bitcoin price eyes $61K as Talos warns of thin Thanksgiving liquidity
items.summary: Bitcoin joined US stock futures in a modest relief rally as Talos questioned crypto demand and the broader outlook for the AI trade.

items.title: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement
items.summary: Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
items.summary: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.

items.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
items.summary: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.

items.title: OpenAI Fixes ChatGPT Billing Error, Promises to Make it 40% Worse
items.summary: OpenAI says a billing mistake made its new AI models cheaper to use than intended. Subscribers will now burn through their allowances faster, but get a free one-time usage reset.

items.title: Elon Musk Says ‘Multiplanetary’ SpaceX Could Be Worth $118 Quintillion. Yes, Quintillion
items.summary: The SpaceX founder claims the firm could one day be worth a million times the global economy, as he pledges free shares to American children.

items.title: Cournot Raises $5M to Build AI-Native Oracle for Verifiable Intelligence
items.summary: The startup uses AI to interpret real-world events for onchain apps and agents, recording evidence and reasoning so outcomes can be audited.

items.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody Says Hackers Accessed Client Contact Details
items.summary: The crypto custodian said an unauthorized party accessed some client and staff names and emails, but found no unauthorized transactions.

items.title: Galaxy Research Withdraws Call That Bitcoin's Bear Market Is Over
items.summary: A month after saying Bitcoin had bottomed in June, Galaxy now says a daily close below $58,525 would signal a materially lower low.

items.title: UK Regulator Cites Binance Hack as It Plans Tougher DeFi Rules Than US and EU: Report
items.summary: The FCA plans to require DeFi platforms to be authorized and to keep regulated exchanges from routing UK retail trades to them.

items.title: New York Wins $1.37B Judgment Against NovaTech Founders Who Fled the US
items.summary: The couple fled the U.S. before a default ruling in 2025, so victims of the scheme may struggle to recover their money.

items.title: China's Google Just Released Its Fast New AI Model for Free
items.summary: Baidu has released the weights of its new high-speed reasoning model, giving developers a commercially usable alternative to proprietary AI services from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic

items.title: What Happened to Alice Huang, the Woman at the Center of Nvidia’s Scandal?
items.summary: U.S. intelligence found no evidence that Beijing directed Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia’s CEO, but the former Megaspeed executive still faces entry bans and scrutiny of business ties.

items.title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
items.summary: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.
